_what: The recorded identity of the deployed artifact. Gates read the namespace from here rather than restating it, so a gate cannot compare a constant with itself.
_module_hash_note: MEASURED on chain, never computed locally. A Pact 5 module hash covers its dependencies' hashes, and the test suite loads a vendored coin snapshot while mainnet runs a different coin — so a locally computed hash will never equal this and proves nothing. VERIFY.md §1 compares the CODE instead.
_audit_note: Reviewed from a cold context by a reviewer with no implementation history, plus an offensive engagement that executed its attacks: 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium. That is NOT a paid third-party engagement, and we do not present it as one.

block_record._note: The contract pins this by hash in its `use`, so it cannot silently settle from a different record.

upgrades.what: The draw is decided by ONE drand evmnet beacon, pinned at a round's first ticket and verified on chain, instead of a block hash. No table or field changed; the two rounds drawn before this keep a block height in decide-height/deciding-block and are refused by every settlement function.

beacon_verifier._note: Sealed (governance can never pass), stateless; the contract pins it by hash in its `use`.

upgrades.block_record: no longer read by the contract
upgrades._note: Appended, never edited: the entries above this one describe the deploy of 2026-09-18 as they were written then.

upgrades.what: A ticket purchase states the digest of the round and terms it was signed for (buy's fifth argument, expect) and is refused on any other. terms-digest and ticket-terms are new and read-only. No table, field or settlement changed.
